chapters.title: The four jobs on every device
Defender for Business vs. Defender for Endpoint

takeaways: Defender for Business brings the same engine as Defender for Endpoint to companies with up to 300 users, packaged with a setup wizard and default policies.
Unlike plain antivirus, its EDR capabilities show what happened, where and what to do next, and can disrupt attacks automatically.
Know the limits before buying: the 300-user cap, five devices per user, separate server licensing and no mixing with Defender for Endpoint Plan 2.
hook: Attackers prefer small businesses because fewer people are watching. This episode explains Microsoft Defender for Business for small and medium companies without a security team: what it does, how to set it up, what it costs and where it stops. You will know whether it fits your organization.
